mapper.sql: id, user_id, source_approval_id, role_id, effective_time, expiration_time, end_reason, end_by, end_note
g.id, g.user_id, g.source_approval_id, g.role_id, g.effective_time, g.expiration_time, g.end_reason, g.end_by, g.end_note, r.name as role_name
mapper.select: select g.role_id as roleId, r.name as roleName, max(g.id) as grantId, max(g.source_approval_id) as sourceApprovalId, min(g.effective_time) as effectiveTime, case when max(case when g.expiration_time is null then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then null else max(g.expiration_time) end as expirationTime, (select count(*) from t_r_data_perm_role_permission p where p.role_id = g.role_id) as permCount from t_r_data_perm_user_role_grant g left join t_r_data_perm_role r on r.id = g.role_id where g.user_id = #{userId} and g.effective_time <= #{asOf} and (g.expiration_time is null or g.expiration_time > #{asOf}) group by g.role_id, r.name order by min(g.effective_time)

select from t_r_data_perm_user_role_grant g left join t_r_data_perm_role r on r.id = g.role_id where g.user_id = #{userId} and g.expiration_time is not null and g.expiration_time <= #{now} order by g.expiration_time desc
select from t_r_data_perm_user_role_grant where role_id = #{roleId} and expiration_time is null
mapper.update: update t_r_data_perm_user_role_grant set expiration_time = #{now}, end_reason = #{endReason}, end_by = #{endBy}, end_note = #{endNote} where id = #{id} and expiration_time is null
mapper.select: select distinct user_id from t_r_data_perm_user_role_grant where effective_time <= #{asOf} and (expiration_time is null or expiration_time > #{asOf})
